name: Balaji Baji Rao
role: Peshwa of the Maratha Empire from 1740 to 1761
contribution: He succeeded his father, Bajirao I, as Peshwa in 1740.

checks.lead: Balaji Baji Rao (8 December 1720 – 23 June 1761), commonly known as Nana Saheb I, was the eighth Peshwa of the Maratha Empire. He succeeded his father, Bajirao I, as Peshwa in 1740.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
